NR_2M_PAGES.description: Number of 2M hugepages to reserve on system boot; for NUMA systems, space-separated per-node counts (e.g., "0 64")

NR_1G_PAGES.description: Number of 1G hugepages to reserve on system boot; for NUMA systems, space-separated per-node counts (e.g., "0 2")

NR_16M_PAGES.description: Number of 16M hugepages to reserve on system boot; for NUMA systems, space-separated per-node counts (e.g., "32 0")

DROPCACHE_BEFORE_HP_ALLOC.description: Set to 1 to drop slab/pagecache before allocating hugepages (default 0)

FREE_PREVIOUS_ALLOCATIONS.description: Set to 0 to disable freeing of previously allocated hugepages (default 1)
